posts.title: Welcome! (A little about me)
posts.description: If you're here, thank you! I probably asked you to be here. A little about me, just going over some basic points, I was born with a genetic condition called Neurofibromatosis Type 1. With this condition, the body becomes more compressed than the average individual. There are a multitude of conditions that can cause structural differences in the body and brain.
